scripts.test:render: npm run build && WEB_SURFACE_MODE=open node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.test:default-surface: env -u NODE_ENV -u WEB_SURFACE_MODE -u WEB_SURFACE_LOCK -u WEB_ENABLE_PRIVATE_SURFACES -u WEB_ENABLE_DEFERRED_SURFACES -u WEB_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_API -u TALKTALK_API_BASE_URL WEB_DEFAULT_SURFACE_TEST=1 sh -c 'npm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs'
scripts.test:production-surface: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production WEB_SURFACE_MODE=open WEB_ENABLE_PRIVATE_SURFACES=true WEB_ENABLE_DEFERRED_SURFACES=true WEB_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_API=true TALKTALK_API_BASE_URL=https://api.talkandtalk.app/api/v1 node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.test:worker-image-runtime: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production WEB_SURFACE_MODE=candidate node --test tests/worker-image-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:policy && npm run test:render && npm run test:default-surface && npm run test:production-surface && npm run test:worker-image-runtime
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
